fact: On 23 January 2026 the two government data centres were inaugurated, housed on sites about 100 km apart to keep service running after a climate or power incident, and a Tier III national data centre is planned for 2028.
title: Souveraineté numérique : le Burkina Faso inaugure deux data center de 3 000 Téraoctets d'un coût de16 milliards F CFA
